acf.hero_eyebrow: SELL FOR MORE MONEY WITH LESS STRESS
acf.familiar_subheading: If you are preparing to sell, you might be asking yourself the same questions we hear every day:

familiar_worries.text: "Who should I hire to do it?"

why_bullets.title: No Out-of-Pocket Costs
why_bullets.desc: We front the money for all cosmetic updates. Every dollar is settled comfortably out of your sale proceeds at closing.

why_bullets.title: No Contractor Headache
why_bullets.desc: Don't worry about finding or managing trades. We handle everything your home needs from painting and flooring to countertops and junk removal.

why_bullets.title: Net More Money
why_bullets.desc: Buyers pay a premium for a finished, move-in-ready home. We handle the stress, and you walk away with a bigger check.

why_bullets.title: Premium Marketing Launch
why_bullets.desc: Once the renovations look perfect, we bring in high-end staging and professional media to make the listing stand out online.

steps.title: Consultation & Audit
steps.desc: Walk through your property together to pinpoint the specific upgrades and repairs that buyers pay a premium for.

steps.title: Upfront Renovation Funding
steps.desc: The Home Prep Program funds 100% of the upfront costs for home improvements and repairs, so you pay nothing out of pocket.

steps.title: Project Management
steps.desc: Trusted local tradespeople are hired and managed to handle absolutely anything your home needs, from paint and flooring to kitchen updates, landscaping, and junk removal.

steps.title: Staging & Media
steps.desc: Transform the refreshed space with premium design styling and high-production photography to drive immediate buyer urgency.

steps.title: High-Profit Close
steps.desc: Secure top-dollar offers, manage final transaction details, and settle the update costs out of proceeds only when escrow closes.

acf.case_body: A smooth two-week renovation timeline featuring fresh paint, new flooring, countertops, cabinet updates, modern lighting, and professional staging pushed the initial list price up, brought multiple offers during the opening weekend, and closed $75,000 above the original valuation.

case_bullets.text: Multiple cash offers received and closed during the first weekend on the market.
Sold for $75,000 over the as-is property valuation before renovations.
All without the owner having to lift a finger or spend a dime up front.

acf.heading: Book a 15-Minute Call With Blake
acf.body: Thinking about selling, but not sure what your home needs before it hits the market? We'll talk through your property, your goals, and what—if anything—would be worth doing before you sell.

expectations.title: See What's Worth Doing
expectations.desc: We'll identify the repairs, updates, cleaning, landscaping, or staging that could make the biggest difference—and what you can skip.

expectations.title: Learn How the Home Prep Program Works
expectations.desc: See how we can coordinate and front the cost of preparing your home for sale, with nothing due until closing.

expectations.title: Get a Clear Game Plan
expectations.desc: Whether you're planning to move soon or sometime down the road, you'll leave knowing what I'd recommend and what your next steps could look like.

acf.body2: No pressure and no obligation. Pick a time that works for you and we'll spend about 15 minutes talking through your home and what you're trying to accomplish.
